key_insight: McQuack replaces the quadratic full Gram matrix with a trainable sample-to-class-centroid quantum fidelity matrix, enabling multiclass kernel learning with linear scaling in the number of training samples.
engineering_relevance: This makes quantum kernel methods more practical for real-world multiclass classification by reducing memory/compute burden while retaining trainability.
method: Train a quantum kernel against class centroids instead of all pairwise training samples.
Use fidelities as kernel outputs to support multiclass prediction.
Evaluate both in simulation and on IBM quantum hardware.
evidence_signal: The authors tested the approach on more than 150 datasets, including simulation and inference on 124 qubits across two IBM devices, with simulation outperforming pure quantum baselines and hardware inference reaching RBF-like performance.
watch_item: Performance depends strongly on parameter initialization, and hardware results were reported for inference without training, so deployment behavior may vary after full optimization.
paper_title: A Multiclass Quantum Aligned Centroid Kernel
